verdictBody: All three indicators remain well below trigger. Continued claims eased to a new 2026 low near 1.70M in late October even as initial claims held flat in the low-200Ks and October payroll growth stayed solid.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims eased to a new 2026 low of 1.697M (week of Oct. 31), keeping this ratio near the bottom of its range and far from the 0.20 trigger.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims fell to 1.697M while payrolls grew a solid +165K in October, pushing this ratio further from the 0.20 threshold.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Initial claims held in a narrow 191K-200K band through early November (200K the week of Nov. 7), showing no meaningful climb toward the threshold.

stats.label: Initial Claims
stats.note: In a 191K-200K band since early Oct.
